hook: The dog has a full-time job.
setup: She supervises every snack, every delivery, and every trip to the bathroom.
punchline: Her performance review is excellent. Mine says: needs more treats.
scene_prompts: A cozy living room with a dog bed and a clipboard, warm photographic still life
A kitchen counter with a cookie jar and tiny paw-print notes
A desk with an employee-of-the-month frame containing a paw print
caption: Apparently, I report to the dog now. Who runs your household?

hook: My phone asked me to prove I am human.
setup: I picked the traffic lights. Then the bicycles. Then a blurry corner of a bus.
punchline: At this point, the robot should be proving it knows what a bicycle looks like.
scene_prompts: A phone and reading glasses on a cozy desk, no legible screen text
A toy bicycle and miniature traffic light on a cream desk
An overwhelmed laptop surrounded by coffee mugs
caption: Being human apparently requires an eye exam. Anyone else fail the bicycle test?

hook: I packed for a three-day trip.
setup: Three outfits. Six backup outfits. Shoes for weather that has not been invented yet.
punchline: The suitcase is prepared for anything. I forgot my toothbrush.
scene_prompts: An open suitcase neatly arranged on a bed
An absurdly overflowing suitcase with many pairs of shoes
An empty toothbrush holder beside an enormous suitcase
caption: Packing light is a lovely theory. What do you always forget?

hook: We agreed on a quiet night in.
setup: Then came the important question: what should we watch? Forty minutes later, we had reviewed everything.
punchline: We finally chose a show. It was called: time for bed.
scene_prompts: Two mugs and a remote on a cozy sofa
A remote beside an enormous stack of generic movie cases
A folded blanket and slippers in a softly lit room
caption: Choosing the show is the whole evening. Sound familiar?

hook: I have reached a very exciting age.
setup: Good parking can improve my entire day. A comfortable chair can change my weekend plans.
punchline: I still chase thrills. Yesterday, I found a coupon that actually worked.
scene_prompts: A comfortable armchair beside a sunny window
A cozy chair with a cup of coffee and a travel brochure
A shopping basket with a small orange coupon card with no text
caption: My definition of adventure has excellent lumbar support.

hook: I went to the store for one thing.
setup: I came home with candles, cookies, and a very convincing little plant.
punchline: The one thing? Still at the store. It needed some independence.
scene_prompts: An empty reusable shopping bag on a kitchen table
A shopping bag overflowing with candles cookies and a small plant
A single lonely carton of milk on a grocery shelf
caption: The shopping list was more of a suggestion. What was your latest accidental purchase?

hook: I started a new productivity routine.
setup: First, I made coffee. Then I organized the mugs. Then I researched better mugs.
punchline: The original task remains untouched. But the mug situation is exceptional.
scene_prompts: A coffee mug beside a blank to-do list
A beautifully arranged collection of coffee mugs
A pristine desk entirely covered with coffee mugs
caption: Productivity has taken a scenic route. What is your favorite productive distraction?
